title: INSTALL OUTPUT SHAFT CENTER BEARING
ocr_text:
MT1–33

W58 MANUAL TRANSMISSION – OUTPUT SHAFT

000868

(d) Install the assembly on the output shaft with the synchronizer ring slots aligned with the shifting keys and turn the inner race to align it with the locking ball.

UN0122

SST

8. INSTALL OUTPUT SHAFT CENTER BEARING
Using SST and a press, install the bearing on the output shaft with the outer race snap ring groove toward the rear.
HINT: Hold the 1st gear inner race to prevent it from falling.
SST 09506–35010

9. INSPECT 1ST GEAR THRUST CLEARANCE
Using a feeler gauge, measure the 1st gear thrust clearance.
Standard clearance:
    0.10–0.25 mm (0.0039–0.0098 in.)
